entries.3b5c315ceed3edf1: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,622 million, an increase of ¥3,759 million year on year. Revenue by segment was: Information Processing Services ¥12,148 million (up 1.4% year on year), Software Development ¥10,127 million (up 37.7%), Other Information Services ¥4,007 million (up 12.4%) and Sale of System Equipment ¥2,338 million (up 19.3%). entries.3c6ffae0997f0c32: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the Group (the Company and two consolidated subsidiaries) has as its main business comprehensive information services, from system consulting to outsourcing, based on 'flexible and speedy IT services that integrate software development and operation.' The business comprises four [[term:segment|segments]]: Information Processing Services, Software Development, Other Information Services and Sale of System Equipment. Because the company was a system-related subsidiary of a city bank, it has a customer base among financial companies, local governments and organizations, and corporations linked to bank transactions, and the annual securities report states that the revenue shares of the financial, public and corporate fields are roughly equal. Its strength is that it can provide one-stop service from consulting through system construction to maintenance and operation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,622 million (up 15.1% year on year).

entries.5a9577dba7e4c098: A reportable segment that, based on its data centers, provides contract computing services centered on large general-purpose mainframes with a 50-year track record, together with peripheral operations such as data entry, printing and delivery, as well as IDC services, cloud services and BPO services. At its "Internet Data Center (Saitama iDC)," it provides 24-hour, 365-day services from system monitoring to operation, with robust facilities and security. Its cloud services include a private cloud service for corporate systems and the targeted attack email training service "Securism." For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥12,148 million (up 1.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥2,032 million (up 5.6%). The securities report cites growth in orders for operations work for financial institutions and an increase in orders for data center and cloud service projects for general corporations. The related companies are the Company, AGS Business Computer Co., Ltd. and AGS Pro Service Co., Ltd.
entries.5f7becad8916efdc: This is a reportable segment that provides a comprehensive range of services to customers in a wide range of industries, including financial institutions, public bodies and general corporations: from system consulting, including information strategy formulation support, to contracted development of application software and design and construction of networks. After obtaining Level 3 certification under the Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), the company formulated its own software development standard, 'AGS Integrated Development Standard (INDESTA)', and develops software while receiving quality checks from a dedicated quality control department. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥10,127 million (up 37.7% year on year), and segment profit was ¥1,817 million (up 51.3% year on year). The securities report cites an increase in orders for DX projects for general corporations and an increase in projects for local governments. The related companies are the company and AGS Business Computer Co., Ltd.

entries.6fab5bd21b15b8a3: The Group consists of the Company and two consolidated subsidiaries, AGS Business Computer Co., Ltd. and AGS Pro Service Co., Ltd. Its predecessors were Saigin Konpyūtā Sābisu, based on Saitama Bank, Ltd., and Shōwa Konpyūtā Sābisu, based on Kyōwa Bank, Ltd.; the two merged in 1995. The consolidated companies have 1,109 employees (average annual number of temporary employees: 848). The annual securities report states that the Company plans to absorb AGS Business Computer through a merger on April 1, 2027.

entries.8b61e5a3a4187b13: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,449 million (up 32.4% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥2,508 million (up 32.0%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,932 million (up 40.1%). The annual securities report cites the increase in revenue and improvements in productivity and profit margin as factors. A gain on sale of investment securities is recorded as extraordinary income. The company currently has no borrowings from financial institutions and in principle funds capital investment and similar needs with its own funds and the use of leases; lease liabilities at the end of the consolidated fiscal year were ¥1,317 million, and cash and cash equivalents were ¥6,174 million.
